thread:
Sam: Heads-up — I'm planning a small rollback-safe change to the /v1/generate default model behavior next week. Need quick align on compatibility windows and comms.
Anya: quick Q — what's the exact behavior change? unpin default or change the default variant?
Sam: Unpin the hard-default so requests without Accept-Model fall back to a configurable default that we can rotate. Previously the default was a static pinned model (redwood-gpt-3.1).
Jordan: ok. Two concerns: SDKs and Dedicated customers. SDKs currently auto-insert no header. If we change fallback semantics we need a client shim or we break some customers.
Maria: Right. Suggestion: emit a warning header X-Redwood-Warning for 30 days when Accept-Model is omitted, and add a telemetry flag for SDKs so we can correlate.
Anya: timeline proposal: announce 2026-04-05, start soft warnings 2026-04-12 (logs + header), hard flip 2026-05-03. Thoughts?
Jordan: I like the phased approach. For Dedicated/private, we should offer a pin override in the tenant config so operators can opt-out of rotation.
Sam: Agreed. We will not auto-rotate Dedicated unless tenant config allows it. Maria, can you add a tenant config flag like allow_default_rotation: true/false?
Maria: Yup — I can add it to the admin API. API shape: PATCH /admin/tenants/:id { "allow_default_rotation": true } and we will surface it in Console.
Anya: Docs + SDKs: We'll add a deprecation note to the JS + Python SDKs calling out Accept-Model behavior and show example:
Anya: ```js
// explicit pin example
const res = client.generate({ prompt, headers: { 'Accept-Model': 'redwood-gpt-3.1' } });
```
Sam: Code-review ping @Anya @Jordan — can you review the swagger change? I pushed a small diff: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4123
Jordan: I can look after my stand. Quick check: should we support both Accept-Model and X-Model-Version? doubling headers may confuse.
Maria: We should canonicalize: Accept-Model is the main header, X-Model-Version will be deprecated. Add a translation layer for one release window.
Sam: Good. Can we also add a runtime metric: fallback_without_header.count and fallback_with_explicit_pin.count so we can measure impact?
deploy-bot: Canary: routing rule update deployed to canary cluster at 10:32 UTC. 1% traffic. :rocket:
Jordan: Nice. For rollback safety, ensure we keep previous pinned variant around for at least 14 days after flip. Ops?
Sam: Will do. Ops note saved in rollout playbook. Also planning a customer e-mail for high-usage customers 1 week before hard flip. Maria, can you draft?
Maria: Drafting now, will share in #customer-success for review.
Anya: One more thing — regression tests: add an integration that hits /v1/generate without header and asserts we return either explicit model name in metadata or warning header.
Jordan: +1. Also include a quick smoke for streaming endpoints.
Sam: Perfect. Action items:
Sam: - Anya: SDK deprecation note + client shim PR (due 2026-04-08)
Sam: - Maria: admin API flag + draft customer email (due 2026-04-02)
Sam: - Jordan: tests + swagger review (due 2026-04-06)
Sam: I'll own rollout playbook and final announce.
Anya: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maria: ack.
Jordan: ack, will review PRs.
deploy-bot: Canary increased to 5% at 12:05 UTC. Logs show 0 errors so far.
Sam: thanks — will post final announce once doc + SDK PRs are merged.
